item.title: Intel Drop: All You Need to Know about the Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 Battle Pass System, BlackCell, and New Store Bundles
item.dc:creator: Call of Duty Staff
item.description:

item.title: Call of Duty: Warzone Season 1: Everything You Need to Know
item.dc:creator: Call of Duty Staff
item.description:
Season 1 marks a major update to Call of Duty: Warzone as the free-to-play combat experience becomes fully integrated with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Deploy to Hajin and Zodiac, play with new gear like the Zipline Launcher and Grabber Drone, buff your Operator with new Elite Perks, and more. Season 1 arrives November 6.

Read the official update

item.title: Modern Warfare 4: Campaign Early Access Now Live
item.dc:creator: Call of Duty Staff
item.description:
Campaign Early Access is now live! Pre-order or pre-purchase Modern Warfare 4 today and experience the epic narrative, featuring sixteen missions taking place across the Korean Peninsula, Paris, New York, and Mumbai as a new invasion threatens to destabilize the world while Price goes on the hunt for the one pulling the strings.
